title: Ellaz dungeon room file
description: A room of the dungeon kind: an n x n tile grid drawn isometrically, what is in the way, where the door and the hero are, who stands where when it begins, and its picture. Positions are CENTI-TILES (100 = one tile, 250 = the centre of tile 2 on that axis) so a file can name a half tile without a float; the grid is VIEW PIXELS. World (x, y) reaches the screen at (ox + (x - y) * tileW / 2, oy + (x + y) * tileH / 2): i runs down-right, j down-left. `art` is the loose object: only a cell opens it, and the gate checks that the scenery set it names exists. What the validator subset cannot write, data.test.ts asserts: every blocked, door and start tile inside the grid, the door and start tiles unblocked, every spawn inside the grid and off a blocked tile, every actor a file on disk, every prop on a blocked tile.

grid.description: n tiles a side; the top corner of tile (0, 0) at view px (ox, oy); a tile spans tileW px across the diamond and tileH px down it

blocked.description: tiles nobody may stand on or walk through: the props

door.description: the threshold tiles just inside the archway; standing on one once the last foe has fallen wins the room

start.description: the hero's actor (the one with a `knight` block), where he begins in centi-tiles, and which way he faces

spawns.description: every foe in the room, from the first tick; the room ends when all have fallen

art.description: the room's picture for the cells: `scenery` names a set under ../assets/ whose `room` clip is the floor and walls (drawn by its top-left at (0, 0)) and whose other clips are the props; `props` places them by clip name on tiles (each must be a blocked tile); `void` is the colour outside the picture. The sim never opens it.

actor.description: a basename under ../actors/ carrying a `slime` or `bat` block

wait.description: ticks before this foe's first attack may come - its cooldown at spawn, so six foes do not strike on one tick
